The '''Nuiri sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].

==History==
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], it was governed by [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Ariss Lyjan]].

{{Stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Although the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed [[Fara's Belt]] in the [[Rolion sector/Legends|Rolion sector]]<ref name="EAOC" />&mdash;information that had originated in ''[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook]]''<ref name="RAS">''[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook]]''</ref> and had been repeated in other sources<ref name="RAS2">[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook (Second Edition)|''The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook'', Second Edition]]</ref><ref name="CSWE Faras Belt">{{CSWECite|I|254|Fara's Belt}}</ref>&mdash;[https://web.archive.org/web/20180325111127/https://www.starwars.com/news/essential-atlas-outer-rim-sectors The Essential Atlas Extra: Outer Rim Sectors] feature of the Online Companion depicted the territory of that sector<ref name="EAOC Outer Rim">{{SW|url=news/essential-atlas-outer-rim-sectors|text=The Essential Atlas Extra: Outer Rim Sectors|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> and the location of Fara's Belt&mdash;as shown on a map in ''The Essential Atlas''<ref name="TEA" />&mdash;as not intersecting. Instead, the feature depicted the location of Fara's Belt as falling within the territory of the Nuiri sector, which this article assumes is incorrect.<ref name="EAOC Outer Rim" />
